request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Revise the PLACEMENT of the portal and temple in our OWN fantasy city concept. The owner likes the ADVENTURERS' GUILD but rejects portal placement in front of it or on the street. Their explicit new request: KEEP THE GUILD and ALSO KEEP THE ORIGINAL SMALL TEMPLE, giving the portal its own dedicated quiet TEMPLE COURTYARD. This is a proposed city placement sketch, not an implemented screenshot.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is our OWN APPROVED guild-building appearance. Preserve that guild hall's dark green roof, timber/ivory walls, large compass/map crest, door, noticeboard, one small hero at board, human/building scale and planted urban style. Image2 is our OWN original city with the SMALL PALE-STONE TEMPLE at its left edge: use that exact modest temple design, terracotta gable roof, simple round window, wooden door/steps; no priest or extra temple service.
WIDER COMPOSITION: make a spacious landscape isometric view of this city quarter, allowing TWO distinct buildings to fit without squeezing or stacking. The approved GUILD remains on LEFT HALF, entrance and paper noticeboard fully visible. At the RIGHT OUTER EDGE of the quarter place the modest original TEMPLE with its OWN quiet ENCLOSED COURTYARD. Ordinary connecting town street is visible BETWEEN the guild zone and temple zone and along the bottom. Keep surrounding cream/timber terracotta homes, gardens and familiar well context where possible; preserve ordinary scale. Slightly widen the view rather than shrink either building disproportionately.
TEMPLE COURT IS THE CRITICAL CHANGE: explicitly separate the entire small court from the public street with a CONTINUOUS LOW PALE-STONE GARDEN WALL and greenery, with ONE WIDE OPEN ENTRANCE. No street crosses through this court. The temple stands toward its back, with steps into the court. Place the ONE existing silver/cyan flat ornamental ground teleport seal ENTIRELY INSIDE THIS ENCLOSURE, on free courtyard cobbles to the SIDE of the temple steps, NOT on the axis of temple door or court gateway. Full ring visible and spaced from walls/flowerbeds by at least one hero-body width. The low wall must not hide the ring. A dedicated short approach leads from court gateway to the portal; the center of the seal is not a through route across town.
REMOVE the old portal from the guild front entirely: plain matching cobblestone there, free door→street and board→street paths. ABSOLUTELY NO PORTAL ON THE PUBLIC ROAD, junction, between garden obstacles or just below the well/bench. It belongs unmistakably to the temple enclosure. One portal total, no portal arch/second point. All outer rings fully on walkable paving, no overlay over bushes, furniture or walls.
Keep the GUILD identity/appearance and both facades with safe margins; the temple is smaller and quieter, not a massive cathedral or a new service hub. Preserve same elevated orthographic3/4 camera, clean soft painted cartoon volumes and warm city palette. No priest/elder, new NPC, quest badge, player UI, map overlays, text except existing guild sign, new currency or religious lore. One readable cohesive original game-world scene.
